items.title: File Widerspruch against the hedge-trimming order
items.quote: Der Widerspruch muss binnen eines Monats, nachdem Ihnen der Bescheid bekannt gegeben worden ist, schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift beim Landratsamt Beispielkreis, Landratsplatz 2, 83043 Musterau, erhoben werden.
items.computation: Letter dated Monday 29.06.2026, sent by post from a Bavarian authority. Under Art. 41(2) BayVwVfG a letter posted domestically is deemed delivered (bekannt gegeben) on the third day after posting, i.e. 29.06.2026 + 3 days = Thursday 02.07.2026 (not a Sunday/holiday, rule applies as-is). The one-month objection period starts the day after Bekanntgabe (§187(1) BGB): 03.07.2026. Per §188(2) BGB a one-month period ends on the day of the last month bearing the same number as the start day of the event, i.e. one month after 02.07.2026 = 02.08.2026. That day, 02.08.2026, is a Sunday, so under §193 BGB the deadline shifts to the next business day: Monday 03.08.2026 (not a Bavarian public holiday).

items.title: Cut back the hedge to the property boundary
items.quote: Wir bitten um Erledigung innerhalb von drei Wochen nach Bestandskraft dieses Bescheids.
items.computation: The order becomes final (bestandskräftig) only after the Widerspruchsfrist expires without an objection being filed. That period ends 03.08.2026 (see Widerspruch item), so, assuming no Widerspruch is lodged, Bestandskraft occurs on 04.08.2026 (Tuesday). Under §187(1) BGB the day of the triggering event (04.08.2026) is excluded, so the three-week period begins 05.08.2026 (Wednesday). Under §188(2) BGB a period of weeks ends with the day of the last week whose name corresponds to the day the period began; counting three weeks from 05.08.2026 gives 12.08.2026, 19.08.2026 and finally 26.08.2026 (Wednesday), which is not a weekend or Bavarian public holiday, so the deadline stands.

warnings: The hedge-trimming deadline (three weeks after Bestandskraft) is not a fixed calendar date in the letter; it depends on whether a Widerspruch is filed. The computed date of 2026-08-26 assumes no Widerspruch is lodged and Bestandskraft occurs immediately once the objection period lapses; if a Widerspruch is filed, this deadline is suspended and a new date would apply once the Widerspruch procedure concludes.
